change: CEP-18 methods and the installer receive typed Python parameters; named argument loading stays in the shared dispatcher.

semantics.requiredDynamicArguments: Annotated[T, Argument(abi=False)] requires an invocation argument while omitting it from generated registration metadata.
semantics.optionalArguments: OptionalArg[T] distinguishes absent arguments from supplied values; defaults and MISSING retain their existing behavior.
semantics.decodingErrors: Argument(error=SomeError) remaps ABIError while preserving MissingArgument and host ApiError exceptions.
semantics.guards: entry_point(before=...) runs the named instance guard once, before boundary decoding, and also on ordinary local calls.
semantics.init: Required package_hash and contract_hash remain absent from the upstream parameterless ABI. AlreadyInitialized precedes argument loading.
semantics.changeSecurity: Optional admin_list, minter_list and none_list are injected. Mint/burn and authorization guards precede decoding; malformed lists retain User 60011, 60012 and 60013.
semantics.installer: All eight inputs are declared in the signature. Supplied arguments validate before the install/upgrade branch, including creation-only inputs on upgrades.
semantics.localCalls: Ordinary Python arguments and catchable exceptions; no named argument loading or boundary decoding.

validation.bootstrapProbes: Initial subprocess build failure; standalone rebuild and complete 52-test rerun passed.
